protocolFix: STP retains the last valid local root/alternate/backup eligibility until each received-vector expiry is processed. Expiry on another port can no longer erase eligibility and incorrectly promote a simultaneously expired alternate port into designated forwarding. The tracking is private runtime state and resets with the heartbeat attachment/runtime.
scope: Adds the catalog lab, bounded loss/protection and observed-incident lesson criteria, and the STP expiry-race correction. No new CLI syntax or dependencies. Completed references exercise actual delivered BPDUs, loss, expiration and recovery; incident and traffic credit are not fabricated. One-way loss affects all frames in that direction, not just BPDUs. No live CML validation is claimed.
verificationNotes: Both root and alternate failures are staged only after receiving normal BPDUs. The guide explains that Loop Guard cannot detect a link that never received BPDUs and that an interface shutdown is different from a physically up one-way failure.
The simultaneous-loss regression tests the real protocol fix; cold-start and designated-port cases protect against false loop-inconsistent states.
